title: acp/1 hand-raise
description: Modeled directly on the `HandRaise` sketch in docs/agent-communication-protocol.md ('Floor control'): participant, reason, urgency, in_reply_to. UNLIKE message.v1.json and (partly) report.v1.json, there is currently NO code in agent-comms/src/acp that constructs, emits, or validates this shape -- grep for HandRaise/Reason in agent-comms/src/acp turns up nothing. Today a hand-raise signal, if sent at all, is just an ordinary Envelope with kind="hand-raise" and a free-text `body`; it carries no structured `reason` or `urgency`. This schema is therefore the doc's *intended* v1 shape, not a description of any existing implementation output, because there is no implementation output to describe yet. See docs/decisions.md (2026-09-29) -- this is flagged as a gap for the FloorPolicy / M2.6 work, not fixed here.

reason.description: The doc's `Reason` StrEnum: ADDRESSED, NEW_POINT, DISAGREE, AGREE_PASS -- serialized here as their StrEnum values.
